note: M27 (D-060): the one source of truth for the Vanilla / HD+ / Custom presets. tools/r3hd_settings.py resolves it; tools/play.ps1 parameter defaults must equal the vanilla column (m27_settings_regression.py). Categories: mandatory = native compatibility / safety, the same in every preset and not a preference (a different value is a diagnostic launch only); platform = native PC behaviour with a console-faithful default; hd_correction = reversible correction of an inherited Xbox 360 HD defect; enhancement = optional quality of life; experimental = insufficiently verified, Custom only and only with allow_experimental. M30 (D-067): scope 'preset' (the default) = decided by the preset, changed only in Custom; scope 'preference' = a per-installation choice, the same default in every preset, adjustable under any preset and kept when the preset changes. group / label / help / value_labels are what the installer and the Settings launcher show (tools/r3hd_installer.py launcher-model); the launcher holds no setting of its own. M31 (D-068): install_default = the value a brand-new installation stores (a preference only; upgrades and repairs keep their settings.json); ui 'hidden' = resolved and kept but not shown in the launcher or configure; requires = the setting applies only while another setting has that value (the launcher disables it otherwise).

presets.vanilla: Xbox 360 HD presentation and gameplay with the essential native PC compatibility and safety behaviour.
presets.hdplus: Vanilla plus the curated, evidence-supported corrections whose validation gate has passed, and those marked provisional that the person chose to include before their in-game look (M43, D-080).
presets.custom: A base preset (vanilla or hdplus) plus individually chosen overrides of adjustable settings.

vanilla.name: Vanilla
vanilla.text: The Xbox 360 release, with the fixes it needs on PC.

hdplus.name: HD+ (Recommended)
hdplus.text: Fixes visual issues inherited from the Xbox 360 HD release.

custom.name: Custom
custom.text: Pick each correction yourself, including unchecked ones.

revisit.label: Revisit-mode progression fix
revisit.why: progression safety: without it a finished or re-chosen revisit can strand a save in the end-of-game hub

pacing.label: Frame pacing (exact 60 Hz simulation step)
pacing.why: the title's 16 ms simulation step of an exact 60 Hz vblank; pinned polling is for comparison only

display.label: Display mode
display.why: the runtime's own borderless fullscreen at the desktop mode (M15); a window otherwise. A new installation starts in fullscreen (M31, D-068); an existing installation keeps its choice

window_size.label: Window size
window_size.help: In screen pixels, for Window mode; reduced to fit your screen. The rendering resolution is set separately.
window_size.why: the SDL window's client size in physical pixels; the guest video mode stays 1280x720 and the rendering resolution is a separate setting

render_scale.label: Rendering resolution
render_scale.help: The size the game draws its 3D image at. Auto follows your screen or window (up to 2160p). Higher sizes need a faster graphics card.
render_scale.why: the same 1280x720 frame drawn at a larger internal size; 1 is the original resolution

layer_coords.label: Separate texture coordinates for two-layer effects
layer_coords.help: Makes haze and cloud layers move separately in the Bog of Murk and Land of the Livid Dead.
layer_coords.validation: passed (D-054): mechanism VERIFIED from the title's own shaders and traces; hidden before / after runs judged by m23_regression.py --pair; visually indistinct to the user, which D-054 counts for neither side
layer_coords.why: two-layer translucent sheets sample both layers on the first coordinate set in the HD release

texture_orient.label: Correct Robo-Pirate statue textures
texture_orient.help: Fixes the texture orientation on four statues in Hoodlum Headquarters.
texture_orient.validation: provisional (M43, D-080: in HD+ at the person's request before gate G-HDP-2): transformation VERIFIED offline and delivery byte-exact, the room not yet seen in the renderer with the option on
texture_orient.why: four Robo-Pirate statue pages stored the other way up from their meshes

gameplay_subtitles.label: Gameplay subtitles
gameplay_subtitles.help: Also outside cutscenes. The game's Subtitles option still applies.
gameplay_subtitles.validation: M44 (D-081): the title's rule VERIFIED from its code and hidden traces; D-090: a per-installation preference (Settings > Corrections), on for a fresh HD+ installation
gameplay_subtitles.why: the Xbox 360 HD release shows gameplay voice subtitles only in cinematic mode or for a fixed list of lines (title design, not a port defect)

ui_language.label: Settings language
ui_language.help: Language of Settings, independent of the game and its mods.
ui_language.why: Settings UI language is independent of the game; setup initializes it only for a fresh installation

cursor.label: Mouse cursor
cursor.help: Hidden while the game window is in front; moving the mouse shows it.
cursor.why: the console has no pointer; auto hides it over the focused window

save_clock.label: Save times
save_clock.help: The time shown next to saves in the game's menus.
save_clock.why: a console shows save times in its own time zone

discord_presence.label: Discord Rich Presence
discord_presence.help: Share the game identity and elapsed session time with Discord.
discord_presence.why: Share only the game identity and elapsed session time with a running Discord client

dualsense_light.label: DualSense light bar
dualsense_light.help: The light bar takes the colour of the current world. DualSense only; other controllers are never changed.
dualsense_light.why: an Xbox 360 pad has no light bar; a PC DualSense player may want one that follows the game (D-108: on for a new installation or an update from 1.0.0, an absent choice of a 1.0.1 home stays off)

dualsense_trigger.label: DualSense R2 resistance
dualsense_trigger.help: A light R2 resistance in gameplay, felt as soon as you press it. DualSense only; it never changes what R2 does.
dualsense_trigger.why: an Xbox 360 pad has no adaptive trigger; an optional, gentle effect for DualSense players (D-108: on for a new installation or an update from 1.0.0, an absent choice of a 1.0.1 home stays off)

dualsense_trigger_strength.label: Adaptive Trigger Strength
dualsense_trigger_strength.help: 0% turns the resistance off. Applies the next time the game starts.
dualsense_trigger_strength.why: the R2 resistance force as a percentage of the D-105 force (100% = force 60); the start position, R2's input and gameplay are never scaled

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Standard keeps session logs small and only the 10 newest. Choose Detailed when asked for a problem report. Saves are never affected.
diagnostics.why: release diagnostics bounded by default (two rotated log files, repetitive known lines sampled, the 10 newest sessions of an installed home); detailed = the M30 behaviour
